name: ClawHub
summary: Public registry for OpenClaw skills (SKILL.md bundles) and plugins, with versioning, vector search, moderation and a CLI for publishing.
description: Browse and render skills, publish versions with changelogs and tags, search via embeddings, star and comment; admins and moderators curate. Also a native OpenClaw package catalog for code plugins, bundle plugins and experimental whole-agent Claw packages. OpenClaw installs and updates from it; the ClawHub CLI handles auth and publishing. Publishing signs in with GitHub. Skills are third-party content: review before installing.
